text:
FIFA Wiadi Kɔp a ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔyɛe wɔ Italy fi 27 May kɔsi 10 June 1934 no, na ɛyɛ nea wɔyɛe wɔ Europe a edi kan na ɛyɛ nea amammui nso de bɛhyɛ mu sɛ ɛte sɛ bɔɔl: wɔyɛe agorɔ no wɔ Benito Mussolini's Fascist regime ase na wɔde yɛ propaganda. Akuo 16 na wɔkɔɔ finals no, nanso ɛyɛ nea edi kan a Wiadi Kɔp no hia qualifying matches, a wɔde akuo 32 bɛyɛ 16, na ɛyɛ nea edi kan a ɔman a ɛyɛ host no nso hia sɛ ɔkɔ qualifying. Akuo a ɛdi hene no Uruguay amma, ɛyɛ nea ɛbaa nea defending champion amma agorɔ no.

Agorɔ no kɔɔ so sɛ straight knockout fi round of 16, na wonni group stage na wɔhyɛ replay bere biara a match no kɔpem extra time akyi. Ɛno na ɛmaa replayed match a edi kan wɔ Wiadi Kɔp abakɔsɛm mu, ɛberɛ a Italy's quarter-final a ɛwɔ Spain nti wɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ da a ɛdi hɔ. Wɔka sɛ total attendance yɛ about 363,000 wɔ agorɔ no nyinaa mu, average yɛ roughly 21,000 per match.

Italy kɔɔ final no kɔhyiaa Czechoslovakia wɔ Stadio Nazionale PNF wɔ Rome, wɔ nnipa bɛyɛ 55,000 anim. Czechoslovakia's Antonin Puc buee scoring no wɔ 71st minute, nanso Raimundo Orsi equalised maa Italy wɔ 81st no. Ɛkɔɔ so sɛ 1-1 wɔ ninety minutes akyi, match no bɛyɛɛ Wiadi Kɔp final a edi kan a ɛkɔ extra time, faako a Angelo Schiavio bɔɔ winner no wɔ 95th minute maa 2-1 victory. Italy nti bɛyɛɛ host nation a edi kan a ɔwie Wiadi Kɔp no.

Czechoslovakia wiee sɛ runners-up, Germany dii mmiensa na Austria dii nnan. Agorɔ no top scorer ne Czechoslovakia's Oldrich Nejedly a ɔwɔ goals anum, a ɛka hat-trick a ɔbɔɔ Germany wɔ semi-final no. Wonni official best player anaa Golden Ball award wɔ agorɔ yi mu.
